notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds governmental (School Nutrition is in Other Governmental Funds; no business-type column). Receipts/disbursements from the governmental funds statement Total column (p3); Total column prints transfers as blank so transfers in/out are computed from the fund columns (187,500 each, net zero). Other local receipts 23,500 split into donations 3,500 and other 20,000 using the General Fund budget schedule (p8). Student support services 940,234 split into General Fund 322,134 and Activities Fund 618,100 (fund columns, p3). Beginning balance is printed as restated (4,510,242). Roll-forward: 4,510,242 + 9,880,609 - 9,903,828 + 187,500 - 187,500 = 4,487,023. Balance sheet from the cash-basis net position section of p2 (no liabilities; printed '- 0 -' on p4). Detail: General Fund from the line-by-line budget and actual schedule (pp8-11), which supersedes the function-level General Fund Components schedule (pp5-6, not recorded to avoid double counting); the Depreciation and Employee Benefit components are recorded from their own budget schedules (pp12-13); Qualified Capital Purpose Undertaking Fund has no activity (p18). Budget schedule shows budget only at group level for most expenditure lines, so budget_final is null on those. Hidden transfer: General Fund student transportation (2710+2730 = 694,917) includes 125,000 transferred to the Activities Fund (reclassification column p6; Activities Fund receipt p14), recorded as a contra expenditure line -125,000 plus an other financing line -125,000; the General Fund 8000 line 177,500 is 125,000 to Depreciation plus 52,500 to School Nutrition. The General Fund expenditure total 8,153,911 includes both the 177,500 and the 125,000 (items 7,976,411 - 125,000 + transfers 177,500 + 125,000). Other transfer cross-checks: Depreciation to Bond 10,000 ties. State programs (72,479) and Federal programs (184,240) are reclassified to Instruction in the statements and are tagged instruction.
